snippet.title: The Book of Outcasts - PC Gameplay
snippet.description:
About The Game 
A disgraced former soldier is recruited into a secretive order of royal investigators to find a rogue mage, but becomes caught up in the politics of a mysterious order of undying wizards and travelling from icy forests to eotic jungles in this RPG dungeon crawler and management sim.

Release Date:30 Oct, 2025
Developer:kamti
Publisher:kamti

The Book of Outcasts Rampage Steam/GOG/itch.io/Epic Games

PC Specs:
CPU:  Intel Core i5-12600K 
GPU:  MSI RTX 5060 8GB Ventus 2X OC White GDDR7
RAM: 32GB (16GBx2) DDR5 6000MHz CL38 TeamGroup T-Force Delta RGB 
MOBO: MSI PRO Z790-P WIFI
Monitor: Gigabyte G24F 2 Gaming
